snippet.title: Haneda Girl – Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Haneda Girl is out now!
Dash, slash, and shoot your way through a neon-drenched 2D arcade rampage.

No difficulty settings — just choose your fighter:
⚡ Haneda for fast-paced action
🧠 Mother for tactical play
⚔️ Switch anytime for a balanced run

🎮 Tight controls, retro pixels, and blood-pumping beats.
💥 Pure arcade energy in a compact, stylish package.

🕹️ Available now on Steam:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169790/Haneda_Girl/

🎮 Play the free demo:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280910/Haneda_Girl_Demo/

💬 Press & Contact:
Press kit
https://tinyurl.com/2szdjwkx

contact email 
marketing.studiokoba@gmail.com

📲 Follow Studio Koba:
🐦 X (Twitter) → https://x.com/studiokoba
📸 Instagram → https://instagram.com/studiokoba

 
❤️ If you like what we made, share it!
Every like, repost, or kind word means the world to our small team.

#HanedaGirl #IndieGame #PixelArt #ArcadeAction #OutNow
